Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find

Class FindStrategyRegistry

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find.FindStrategyRegistry
@Component public class FindStrategyRegistry extends Object
Registry for different find strategies available in the system.

This component acts as a central registry that maps find strategy types to their corresponding implementation functions. It provides a unified way to access various find strategies such as image matching, text finding, color detection, motion analysis, and more. The registry pattern allows for easy extension with custom find strategies.

  • Method Details

    • addCustomFind

      public void addCustomFind(BiConsumer<ActionResult,List<ObjectCollection>> customFind)
      Registers a custom find function that can be used with FindStrategy.CUSTOM.

      This method allows users to extend the find functionality by providing their own implementation. The custom function will be invoked when the action config specifies CUSTOM as the find strategy.

      Parameters:
      customFind - The custom find function to register. Must accept an ActionResult (which will be populated with matches) and a list of ObjectCollections to search within. Must not be null.

    • get

      public BiConsumer<ActionResult,List<ObjectCollection>> get(ActionConfig actionConfig)
      Retrieves the appropriate find function based on the action configuration.

      This method returns the registered function for the specified find strategy based on the ActionConfig type.

      Parameters:
      actionConfig - The configuration specifying which find strategy to use
      Returns:
      The find function corresponding to the specified strategy. May return null if no function is registered for the specified type.

    • get
